verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents broad programmatic coverage: connected accounts, transfers, refunds, subscriptions, invoicing, payment links, webhooks and multi-currency pricing are all API-accessible. Its official CLI and AgentOS MCP let agents read and write production resources. However, nothing in the evidence states that the API matches the web app feature for feature. The CLI covers only "a broad slice" of the API, and some functions, such as webhook delivery inspection and re-delivery, are described only as web-app features. Missing for 10: an explicit documented claim of full API/UI parity, API equivalents for UI-only operations such as webhook re-delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
